response.sql:
WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS film_count
  FROM film AS f
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), above_average AS (
  SELECT film_count,
         AVG(film_count) OVER () AS across_rating_avg
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT SUM(film_count) AS total_films,
       AVG(film_count - across_rating_avg) AS avg_excess
FROM above_average
WHERE film_count > across_rating_avg;

assumptions.assumption: The across-rating average includes only ratings represented among films that have at least one inventory copy.
